newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Atlas Copco may go into new areas - new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Copco may go into new areas - new CEO.

text.p: The new head of Swedish industrial engineer Atlas Copco, Giulio Mazzalupi, said on Monday the company may launch into new operational areas.

"You can work in many dimensions to increase growth and other areas are a possible dimension," Mazzalupi told a press conference, after being named as the company's new chief executive to replace Michael Treschow.
"We have a good platform to increase growth.
"It is important that I will ensure that all plans and strategies continue unchanged until this is carried through."
Mazzalupi will take the helm of Atlas Copco at the end of April when Treschow moves to head appliance maker Electrolux.
